metadata.title: SysNDD Impeccable Design & Lighthouse Audit
metadata.reviewer_calibration: 145 IQ Design Director & Clinical UI/UX Specialist

ratings.title: Home Page
ratings.one_line_verdict: Strong, clean reference surface; minor token hardcodes and slate fallback debt in CSS.

top_findings.issue: Hardcoded background hex #f6f8fb and surface #fff instead of design tokens
Fallback slate colors in CSS variables (#172033, #526070) instead of brand neutrals
Card border shadow hardcoded with slate rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08)

improvements.recommendation: Unify HomeView container and cards to use var(--surface-canvas), var(--surface-raised), var(--border-subtle), and var(--shadow-sm)
improvements.expected_impact: Eliminates one-off CSS and unifies background tone

ratings.title: Entities Table
ratings.one_line_verdict: Excellent table functionality marred by mismatched action button colors and amateurish double-dot filter placeholders.

top_findings.issue: Top-right action buttons use 3 conflicting colors: dark gray (.xlsx), bright green (copy link), and bright cyan (column toggle)
Filter input placeholders use amateurish double-dot format (.. Entity .., .. Symbol .., .. Disease ..)
Details column has repetitive outline blue Show buttons on every single row

improvements.recommendation: Standardize table header actions into a unified neutral outline/subtle button group using --neutral-* and --border-subtle tokens
improvements.expected_impact: Harmonious action cluster across all tables

improvements.recommendation: Replace double-dot placeholders with clean human-crafted labels ("Filter entity...", "Filter symbol...", "All inheritances")

ratings.title: Genes Table
ratings.one_line_verdict: Solid gene index; suffers from truncated header "Hpo mode of inherit...", mismatched buttons, and double-dot placeholders.

top_findings.issue: Column header truncated to "Hpo mode of inherit..." with ugly ellipsis, filter placeholder reads ".. Hpo mode of inherit... .."
Same mismatched header buttons (dark gray .xlsx, green copy link, cyan column toggle)
Double-dot placeholders across all filter inputs

improvements.recommendation: Shorten column header to "Inheritance" or "HPO Inheritance" with full tooltip, clean up filter placeholder
Apply shared unified table action button group

ratings.title: Phenotype Search Table
ratings.one_line_verdict: Functional phenotype query table with chaotic button coloring (orange column toggle, green copy link, dark gray excel) and garbled placeholder punctuation.

top_findings.issue: Column toggle button is styled bright ORANGE/YELLOW, while cyan on Entities/Genes and dark gray elsewhere
Garbled placeholder text ".. Disease ontology ... ." with irregular trailing dots and spaces
High contrast mismatch between filled AND button and unselected OR button

improvements.recommendation: Unify header actions with the shared table toolbar standard, removing one-off orange variant
Clean up placeholder strings to "Filter disease..." and "Inheritance"

ratings.title: Panel Compilation Table
ratings.one_line_verdict: Outlier among public tables: lacks standard category/inheritance chips and uses proportional sans font for database identifiers and genomic coordinates.

top_findings.issue: Category and Inheritance columns render truncated plain text rather than standard semantic chips (.sysndd-chip)
Identifiers (HGNC, Entrez, Ensembl, UCSC, BED coords) use proportional body font instead of --font-family-mono
Column toggle is an inline button in the filter row ("Columns 9/9") rather than an action icon in the header

improvements.recommendation: Convert Category to CategoryIcon + badge and Inheritance to .sysndd-chip badges
improvements.expected_impact: Brings Panels into visual parity with Entities and Genes

improvements.recommendation: Apply font-mono class to HGNC, Entrez, Ensembl, UCSC, and BED coordinate columns

ratings.title: Curation Comparisons (UpSet)
ratings.one_line_verdict: Powerful UpSet visualization weakened by card-in-card nesting, duplicate headers, and duplicate question mark icons.

top_findings.issue: Card inside card anti-pattern: inner bordered card duplicates outer tab title "Overlap"
Duplicate question mark icons "(?) (?)" in inner card header
Source toggle chips use random discordant colors (blue, green, cyan) rather than systematic palette

improvements.recommendation: Flatten inner card chrome into AnalysisShell content, remove duplicate "Overlap" heading
improvements.expected_impact: Removes nested card chrome and visual clutter

improvements.recommendation: Remove redundant second help button and standardize source chips to --medical-blue and --neutral tokens
improvements.expected_impact: Clean, singular help affordance and cohesive colors

ratings.title: Curation Comparisons Similarity Matrix
ratings.one_line_verdict: Critical data visualization omission: cosine similarity heatmap lacks any color scale legend or numerical key.

top_findings.issue: NO COLOR SCALE / LEGEND: heatmap displays shades of dark red to light pink with zero indication of numerical correlation/similarity range
Card-in-card nesting with duplicate "Similarity" header
Excessive whitespace around centered matrix with no supplementary statistics or context

improvements.recommendation: Add clear, token-styled color scale legend bar (0.0 to 1.0) below the matrix plot
Flatten nested card border and integrate controls cleanly into AnalysisShell

ratings.title: Curation Comparisons Table
ratings.one_line_verdict: Valuable cross-database comparison table marred by truncated column headers ("Gene2Phenoty") and overflowing filter dropdowns.

top_findings.issue: Column header truncated to "Gene2Phenoty" and filter dropdowns overflow into arrows (.. Gene2Phenoty, .. Radboudumc.., .. NDD GeneHub)
Header actions repeat mismatched 3-color cluster (dark gray, green, cyan)
Nested card chrome inside AnalysisShell with duplicate title "Curation effort comparisons"

improvements.recommendation: Fix column header width / label truncation and provide clean filter select option labels
improvements.expected_impact: Eliminates text collisions and ugly truncation

improvements.recommendation: Flatten nested card chrome and apply unified table action buttons

ratings.title: Phenotype Correlations (Correlogram)
ratings.one_line_verdict: Severe visual defect: X-axis labels rotated 90 degrees are vertically clipped through the center of the words, rendering them illegible.

top_findings.issue: X-axis labels are vertically CLIPPED through the middle of the text lines ("idney", "ystem", "mality"), completely unreadable
Correlation color scale legend is positioned off-screen / pushed below default viewport on desktop
Nested card chrome with redundant "Matrix of phenotype correlations" title
Tab bar overflows on mobile without visual scroll cues

improvements.recommendation: Increase bottom SVG/plot margin and configure proper text-anchor and padding so rotated HPO term labels never clip
improvements.expected_impact: Restores primary scientific readability of the correlogram

improvements.recommendation: Position correlation legend alongside or immediately beneath chart within the visible frame

ratings.title: Phenotype Counts Bar Plot
ratings.one_line_verdict: Frequency chart suffers from overlapping, crammed 45-degree rotated category labels on the X-axis.

top_findings.issue: X-axis bar labels are rotated 45 degrees and overlap into each other, creating an unreadable dense strip
Nested card chrome inside AnalysisShell with duplicate title
Lack of interactive hover tooltip or value display on bars

improvements.recommendation: Improve label spacing, consider horizontal bar layout or intelligent font scaling with hover highlights
Flatten nested card border into AnalysisShell body

ratings.title: Phenotype Clusters Network & Synthesis
ratings.one_line_verdict: Lowest scoring page: 3 failing Lighthouse accessibility audits (1.5:1 yellow AI contrast, heading order, button name mismatch), garish consumer-AI sparkle tropes, and broken mobile export buttons.

top_findings.issue: FAILING WCAG CONTRAST (1.5:1): Yellow "AI" label (#ffc107 on #fff6da) is virtually invisible and severely fails AA requirement
HEAVY AI SMELL & TELL: Consumer-style sparkle emoji "✨ AI Summary — Cluster 1" and fake "Verified" badge degrade clinical credibility
FAILING HEADING ORDER: Card uses <h6> for "Organ-system involvement", skipping h2-h5 levels
ACCESSIBLE NAME MISMATCH: .xlsx button has visible text ".xlsx" but aria-label "Download table data as Excel file" without matching text
Cluster link #0d6efd on #fafafa has contrast 4.31:1, failing AA 4.5:1 requirement
Mobile export buttons collapse into giant empty rectangle blocks

improvements.recommendation: Eliminate sparkle emojis and "✨ AI Summary"; rebrand to dignified clinical nomenclature: "Cluster Synthesis" or "Phenotypic Profile"
improvements.expected_impact: Zero AI smell; restores clinical research credibility

improvements.recommendation: Fix all 3 a11y failures: replace yellow AI badge with high-contrast token pill, fix h6 -> h3, align button accessible name to include "xlsx", use --medical-blue-700 (8.59:1) for cluster link
improvements.expected_impact: Restores Lighthouse a11y score from 96 to 100

improvements.recommendation: Fix mobile button sizing so export buttons remain compact icon buttons

ratings.title: NDDScore Machine Learning Predictions
ratings.one_line_verdict: Overly defensive card-in-card disclaimer stack with sparkle emojis forces the actual prediction table below the fold.

top_findings.issue: AI SMELL & TELL: Consumer-style sparkle emoji "✨ ML prediction" used in header badge and banner card
Massive disclaimer banner with nested metric cards (AUC-ROC, Brier) consumes entire initial viewport, especially on mobile
Filter select option text overlaps dropdown arrow (".. Top inherita")
Inconsistent placeholder styles (mixing "Filter Gene", "Any NDD sco...", and ".. Risk tier ..")
Same mismatched header buttons (dark gray, green, cyan)

improvements.recommendation: Remove sparkle emojis; distill model disclaimer into a compact, elegant metadata header strip with inline metrics (AUC-ROC, Brier score) instead of a giant multi-card stack
improvements.expected_impact: Immediate table visibility, zero AI smell, compact clinical density

improvements.recommendation: Standardize filter placeholders to clean "Filter [Field]" or "All [Field]" format, avoiding text truncation into select arrows
Apply shared unified table action buttons
